mcqs.question: Which article of the Indian Constitution guarantees the Right to Constitutional Remedies?
mcqs.explanation: Article 32 allows a person to move the Supreme Court for enforcement of fundamental rights. Dr B. R. Ambedkar called it the heart and soul of the Constitution.

mcqs.question: Which amendment added the words 'socialist' and 'secular' to the Preamble of India?
mcqs.explanation: The 42nd Amendment Act, 1976 added 'socialist', 'secular' and 'integrity' to the Preamble.

mcqs.question: Which part of the human eye regulates the amount of light entering it?
mcqs.explanation: The iris adjusts the size of the pupil, controlling how much light reaches the retina.

mcqs.question: What is the SI unit of electrical capacitance?
mcqs.explanation: Capacitance is measured in farads (F). One farad equals one coulomb of charge stored per volt.

mcqs.question: Who authored 'The Discovery of India'?
mcqs.explanation: Jawaharlal Nehru wrote The Discovery of India while imprisoned during the Quit India movement.

mcqs.question: Pehowa, the town known for its ancient pilgrimage sites, is in which district of Haryana?
mcqs.explanation: Pehowa is a sub-district and pilgrimage town in Kurukshetra district, Haryana.

mcqs.question: Which city serves as the capital of both Haryana and Punjab?
mcqs.explanation: Chandigarh is a Union Territory and the shared capital of Haryana and Punjab.

mcqs.question: Which river flows through the city of Varanasi?
mcqs.explanation: Varanasi lies on the banks of the Ganga, one of the oldest continuously inhabited cities in the world.

cafeChecklist.label: Government photo ID
cafeChecklist.detail: Carry a valid original ID and a clear digital copy. Match the name exactly on every form.

cafeChecklist.label: Address proof
cafeChecklist.detail: Keep a PDF or photo of one accepted address document ready before reaching the counter.

cafeChecklist.label: Passport-size photo
cafeChecklist.detail: A recent JPEG under 200 KB works for most online uploads and reduces retry time.

cafeChecklist.label: Form fields saved as text
cafeChecklist.detail: Type repeated details into a local draft so you are not retyping them on a shared keyboard.

cafeChecklist.label: Scan legibility check
cafeChecklist.detail: Confirm all four corners are visible and the text can be read before transmitting.

cafeChecklist.label: Logout and clear downloads
cafeChecklist.detail: Sign out of every portal and remove temporary files from the shared machine before leaving.
